title: Grieving the Holy Spirit
definition: Grieving the Holy Spirit means causing sorrow by sinning against the God who dwells within believers.
summary: The Spirit is grieved by bitterness, corrupt speech, disobedience, unbelief, and sin that contradicts the life of Christ.
christFocus: Because Christ redeemed believers, they are called to live in a way that honors the Spirit who seals them.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit is grieved by bitterness, corrupt speech, disobedience, unbelief, and sin that contradicts the life of Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
